answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor cryptographic attestation chains across a web of trust trellis. Zero-knowledge proofs verify execution validity without leaking state. To scale pseudonyms, a peer must pay collateral that doubles per identity, creating an exponential capital exhaustion mechanism. Like a gale snuffing fragile sparks, this superlinear cost burns Sybil swarms instantly, leaving only legitimate nodes tracking true execution like a comet.
